profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer
profile.summary:
I want to build sustainable systems.

Into: Agile/Scrum, JavaScript, CoffeeScript, Regular Expressions aka "RegEx", PHP, Python, Git, Gulp, Terminal, Continuous Integration, Apache, Bamboo, JIRA, Confluence, Gherkin, Test Driven Development, Node.js, Ember, Backbone, Marionette, Data, D3.js, HTML5, CSS, Stylus, Rachelle's BEM-like methodology, Schema.org, user-centered design, project scoping, mobile-first, fluid, responsive design, accessibility standards.

Not into: SVN, rebasing in Git, strict waterfall workflow, PNG icons instead of SVGs, Lorem Ipsum, [too much] code smell.

Stack recently: NodeJS, EmberJS, BackboneJS w/ Marionette, a tad ReactJS, RxJS, (would love to do more functional JS programming). Gulp for task runner.
 
The last couple years I've worked almost exclusively on front end/back end Node web apps - Single Page Apps- or front end node integrated with PHP API & MySQL. Continuous Delivery & Integration with Bamboo, Stash/Bitbucket, CucumberJS for Behavior Tests, JIRA for ticketing. Documentation with Confluence. Git all the way for version control. 

Languages are JavaScript ( CoffeeScript the last two years), RegularExpressions. I'm learning Python; I've worked with PHP, Java and C# but I'm most interested in Python. HTML 5, Handlebars for templating, CSS3 with focus on Stylus for preprocessor. 

I built out a cool interactive data viz chart on the Jurassic World website with NVD3 (based on D3.js). I have previous experience with e commerce. I am more inspired by useful tools & data than I am by flashy UI.

I've been the lead Agile Dev  here at TP for a while. I do a good amount of scoping, developing product requirements, improving code quality & standardizing FE architecture & improving process. I've been the dev or FE lead on half a dozen projects the last year or two. I care about people, quality, and getting things done.

Always learning--there is so much more to learn!

- Clients include Netflix and Amazon

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Fulfill concurrent web development positions at the Deep Focus global agency and Trailer Park.

positions.title: Web Developer (Freelance)
positions.description:
•	Produce interactive HTML & JavaScript widgets for iPad multi-touch books. Manage project from design conversion and UI adaptation (print layout to a mobile, digital touch interface) to delivery. This includes planning the schedule and time required, wireframing, storyboarding interaction, outlining technical specifications, collaborating with other designers and developers, programming, monitoring progress of team members, user testing, and presenting the completed application to the art and technical directors.
•	Led a six-person team development project for a 700-plus page print book to fixed-layout EPUB conversion, meeting a strict deadline in a sped-up production environment.
•	Managed data conversion, asset inventory, and prototype development for a large-scale widget project; co-authored PHP script for widget production and data/file cloning.
•	Support Art Director and Technical Director by developing reports, proposals, and spreadsheets for project management, asset inventory, and file archiving systems. Provide training and support to team members on interactive application coding for iPad books, producing complex layouts in iBooks Author, and promoting department standards and best practices. 
•	Convert print books to fixed layout (EPUB) and multi-touch format.

positions.title: Front End Web Developer, Project Manager, Consultant
positions.description:
•	Draft and implement solutions for entrepreneurial, nonprofit, and commercial clients to leverage the online, mobile, and print media and effectively communicate with their target audience. Formulate branding campaigns and maintain Web sites.  Utilize SEO, social media integration, usability testing and analytics to maximize functionality and exposure of relevant pages.
•	Rebuilt the e-commerce site for calleencordero.com, executed front end development. Customized the design, modified the existing template system, upgraded the store platform, migrated the product & customer database, and modified the catalog interface.
•	Rebuilt the calleencordero.com showcase site in XHTML/CSS/Jquery (from Flash site).
•	Successfully merged interface design specifications for ikowilson.com, coordinating PHP script, multiple JQuery plugins, CSS and HTML, extensive WordPress customization. 
•	Produced beta Web site for a social networking iPhone application featured on the iTunes home page.
•	Design, execute, and maintain online presence for  PR firms, musicians, filmmakers, small business owners, non-profits, and community activist groups.

positions.title: Front End Developer/Web Production Artist
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with Web, IT, Marketing and Production team members to enhance the fitness and health-centered Beachbodycoach.com and Teambeachbody.com experience for site visitors and consumers. Maintained online store and built sell pages; produced and deployed targeted and general emails that achieved cross browser/platform/device compatibility.
•	Enhanced email templates and newsletters; created and analyzed tracking links.
•	Proposed and implemented calls to action in a periodic email to 700K recipients to generate click throughs to the online store.
•	Created and maintained landing pages; managed repository, coordinated file migration to production server, maintained version control with TortoiseSVN
•	Contributed to the re-launch of the community site Teambeachbody.com.
•	Built Shakeology landing pages; Beachbody coaches weekly sell $1 million of the successful product.

positions.title: Development Assistant
positions.description:
• Maximized limited assets, revitalized communications including Web site, graphic promotions, and email blasts
• Translated fundraising needs into development specifications. 
• Maintained and enhanced donor database, reduced distribution list error by 15%.
• Networked with administration at the University of Southern California, negotiating a donation that increased the size of the organization's computer network by 100%.
• Produced video that garnered grant monies to cover 5% of that year's operating expenses.
• Curated a photography exhibit that continues to attract positive media attention.

volunteerExperiences.description:
I mentor at NodeSchool LA Workshops.

NodeSchool is an open source project run by volunteers with two goals: to create high quality programming curriculum and to host community learning events.

http://nodeschool.io/about.html
